leads.name: Inchmahome Priory sweet chestnuts (three)
leads.approx_location: Inchmahome island, Lake of Menteith, 56.1766,-4.2841 (approx, unchecked)
leads.reason: HES visitor page: three gnarled sweet chestnuts thought to date from the 1500s; HES garden inventory says Nuns' Walk chestnuts probably planted c.1660s (conflict); access by boat with ticket (paid, seasonal); no girth, no per-tree coordinate, no photo checked. Not within 30 min of Stirling by PT.

leads.name: Giant sequoia, Memorial Park (Pullar), Keir Street, Bridge of Allan
leads.approx_location: Bridge of Allan, Memorial Park, Keir Street boundary
leads.reason: Parks and Gardens UK (search summary): single giant redwood about 27 m, no planting date, no girth; a second tree (redwoodworld) stands near Chalmers Church, unrelated. Needs a page fetch for height and a girth/age source; 5 min by train from Stirling, so the best day-trip lead.
